title: Add evaluator_clean writer — fix phase 3/4/5 wire-in gap
description: Fixed the production pipeline gap: the production Phase 3/4/5 code writes strategy files via direct json.dump (not through Output_Writer.write), so the evaluator_clean files were never created during a real pipeline run. Added _maybe_write_evaluator_clean() helper in writer.py and wired it into all 5 json.dump call sites across the three phase files.
notes_for_reviewer: Added _maybe_write_evaluator_clean(strategy, main_path, direction) in output/writer.py alongside write_evaluator_clean.
The helper is gated by bool(getattr(_cfg, 'WRITE_EVALUATOR_CLEAN', True)) and wraps write_evaluator_clean in a try/except that logs at DEBUG level (non-fatal).
Wired into: phase3_rule_set._persist_output, phase4_wf_optimizer.optimize_risk, phase4_wf_optimizer.train, phase4_wf_optimizer.optimize_risk_grid, phase5_oos._remove_negative_pnl_rules.
Each phase file imports _maybe_write_evaluator_clean and write_evaluator_clean from gpu_fuzzy_trader.output.writer.
4 new tests for _maybe_write_evaluator_clean: flag=true writes, flag=false skips, parent dir creation, missing keys handled gracefully.
All 63 tests pass (50 original output_writer + 9 evaluator_clean + 4 new).
The existing Output_Writer.write wire-in is preserved (still valid for callers who use the class-based path).
